script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Two FRIENDS, JANE (30s, quirky, optimistic) and MARK (30s, cynical, pessimistic), sit across from each other, each sipping a cup of coffee.

JANE
(smiling)
You know what they say, Mark?

MARK
(skeptical)
What's that, Jane?

JANE
That every day is a new opportunity?

MARK
(snorting)
You really believe that, don't you?

JANE
(cheerfully)
Absolutely! And today, I'm going to prove it to you.

CUT TO:

EXT. PARK - DAY

Jane and Mark walk through the park, sharing stories about their lives. Mark opens up about his failed relationship and feeling stuck in his job. Jane encourages him to take a chance and pursue his dream of becoming a writer.

MARK
(laughing)
And how do you suggest I do that?

JANE
(smiling)
Well, I have an idea. Follow me.

CUT TO:

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Jane and Mark enter the library. Jane leads Mark to a quiet corner, where they find an old typewriter.

MARK
(surprised)
Where did you get this?

JANE
(grinning)
It was here when I last checked. You can use it to start writing your masterpiece.

MARK
(skeptical)
And what makes you think I can write a masterpiece?

JANE
(confidently)
Because you have a story to tell, Mark. And it's never too late to start.

CUT TO:

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Jane walks Mark home. They share a heartfelt conversation about the importance of taking risks and embracing change.

MARK
(serious)
Thanks, Jane. This has been a great day.

JANE
(smiling)
Glad I could be a part of it.

CUT TO:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY (ONE WEEK LATER)

Jane and Mark sit across from each other, each sipping a cup of coffee.

MARK
(excited)
Jane, you won't believe it! I wrote something!

JANE
(smiling)
I knew you could do it!

MARK
(eager)
Want to read it?

Jane nods enthusiastically as Mark reads his first page aloud. The coffee shop fades away as they become fully engrossed in Mark's story.

FADE OUT.

---

THE END

(Note: Additional scenes can be added to expand upon the characters and their journey, as needed.)
